[[Mistralton Cave]] }} '''A Week to Go and Old Wounds''' (Japanese: '''VS コバルオン・テラキオン・ビリジオン I''' ''VS Cobalion, Terrakion, Virizion I''), titled '''VS Cobalion / Terrakion / Virizion I''' in the [[Shogakukan Asia]] translation, is the 506th chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the 46th chapter of the {{MangaArc|Black & White}}. It is subtitled '''Cobalion, Terrakion, Virizion I''' (Japanese: '''三剣''' ''Three Swords'') in the [[VIZ Media]] translation and '''A Week to Go and Old Wounds''' in the Shogakukan Asia translation. ==Plot== {{Incomplete plot}} ==Major events== * {{adv|Black}} decides to capture some [[Legendary Pokémon]] in hopes that it will get him access into the {{un|Pokémon League}} without an eighth [[Badge]]. * Black travels to the [[Mistralton Cave]], where he encounters {{DL|Swords of Justice (Adventures)|Virizion}} and {{DL|Swords of Justice (Adventures)|Terrakion}}. * Black meets [[Shoko]] of the [[Marvelous Bridge]] {{p|Patrat}} Show and her friend Trish of {{tc|the Riches}} family. * [[Iris]] meets up with [[Cedric Juniper]]. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== * [[Shoko]] * {{tc|The Riches|Trish}} ====Pokémon debuts==== * {{p|Heatmor}} * {{p|Terrakion}} ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|Black}} * {{adv|White}} * [[Iris]] * [[Cedric Juniper]] * [[Ingo]] * [[Emmet]] * [[Shoko]] * {{tc|The Riches}} Trish ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Braviary}} ([[Brav]];
